newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai mobile phone capacity to triple this year.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai mobile phone capacity to triple this year.

text.p: Shanghai will triple the capacity of its mobile phone networks this year from 455,000 to 1.4 million users, the official Xinhua news agency reported on Friday.
The agency said the city planned to add 300,000 new cellular phone users by the end of this year, on top of the existing 330,000 users in 1996.
The city's digital GSM network will expand fastest, with capacity rising from 200,000 users to 800,000 users, it said.
In the first two months of this year, Shanghai registered a daily average of 500 new mobile phone users per day, the agency added.
